desc: 白底加剖面讲结构，四格场景讲百搭，尺寸与空白背书收口
name: 负重训练背心贴身稳定款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼赢下点击，用干净正立面交代整体轮廓与前扣结构。
用一屏剖切结构讲清它为什么穿着训练，替代空洞形容词。
shots.textZone: label rail around the product; headline slot at the bottom third

shots.intent: 让买家把自己代入日常步道加练的画面，建立场景联想。
一屏铺开设定范围，让用户确认自己的日常与居家练法都用得上。
shots.textZone: top-left headline block above the large panel, one small chip per tile

shots.intent: 用一处真实做工细节替代形容词，撑起品质可信度。
回答穿上合不合身、占多大空间，消除下单前最后的疑虑。
shots.textZone: right column copy block; blank dimension rails bracket the product

shots.intent: 收口降风险：真实居家穿戴加两条留白背书带，把主张留给卖家填。
shots.textZone: top rounded proof band and lower centre plate, both carried as empty frames with one placeholder line

style.backgroundSystem: seamless cool white #FFFFFF for the packshot, bone warm-grey #EFEAE4 and light neutral #F4F2F0 panels for infographic frames, sunlit interior #F1ECE6 and pale concrete #C9C2BB for lifestyle, dark charcoal #2F3336 reserved for one macro
style.direction: premium athletic-training commerce, calm studio packshots plus warm real-life training frames
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and dot-anchor leader lines in #E4572E, flat, no gradients, no 3D
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light with a front-left key, fill card on the shadow side and soft contact shadows; lifestyle frames use warm directional daylight at 4200K to 5500K with the same shadow direction as the props; texture reads come from a soft skimming sweep, never from harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium athletic-training ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless cool white #FFFFFF, bone warm-grey #EFEAE4, charcoal text #26282A and one training-orange accent #E4572E; neutral studio temperature with bright even high-key key light from the front-left, fill card on the shadow side and soft contact shadows, warm directional daylight only in lifestyle frames; modern geometric sans-serif with one short headline and no more than five label chips; thin single-weight line icons and dot-anchor leader lines in #E4572E; clean high-end sportswear product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright symmetrical product angle and scale, ghost-mannequin or neck-down cropped wear only; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no inconsistent lighting or mismatched shadow direction
no visible faces, brand marks, certificates or rendered numbers
style.presentationRules: product stays upright and symmetrical, ghost-mannequin or neck-down cropped wear only, consistent strap and closure placement across the set, cutaway panels drawn as a clean section rather than a damaged garment
style.surfaceSystem: matte bone-grey board #EFEAE4 for flat lays, matte concrete and timber for lifestyle, dark seamless #2F3336 under macro
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; one short headline plus at most five label chips, all in charcoal #26282A with a single accented word in #E4572E; no dense body copy
